objective: Build the Rex delta corpus. Cap reviewer hand-backs and set resume rules. Replace the self-declared tier with a script that only gates the current Reduced-Scope pass.
why: ac7-1 to ac7-6 are not-verified in reconciliation-plan-apexyard-token-efficiency-20261019T062054Z. o7 is the only outcome with unmet criteria and no slice. The harness o4 Rex trim merged in #1652, and the o5 slice merged in #1678. The tier is still self-declared in right-size-ceremony.md, and Rex decides the Reduced-Scope pass by itself. A Rex spawn now starts at 26,813 tokens in docs/eval-agents/reports/rex-hakim-token-trim-2026-10-11.md, so the resume window needs new numbers. The ac7-4 evidence gives a mean hand-back of 3,543 bytes, and delta rounds post the 13-section body. docs/perf/token-cost-baseline-2026-10-10.md line 96 gives 3.87 resume rebuilds per 100 reviewer runs. docs/eval-agents/corpus/rex.json has 10 entries and no delta entry, so C4 needs delta entries first. Near-zero Lean PRs merged per week since 2026-10-11, so ac7-2, ac7-3 and ac7-5 wait for a later slice.

include: Use one PR with a step checklist. Step 1 adds the Rex delta corpus entries because they are the C4 precondition.
Step 1: add at least five Rex delta entries to docs/eval-agents/corpus/rex.json from real delta rounds. Run validate-corpus.sh on the file.
ac7-1: add a tier script whose result can only allow the existing Reduced-Scope pass. Rex keeps rail 2 and may still escalate on content.
ac7-1: the review takes the stricter result of the script and Rex.
Anti-forgery: run the script from the base branch or the ops fork at the reviewed SHA. Read the full base..HEAD range.
Anti-forgery: list both sides of each rename and copy. Fail closed to Full on a truncated file list or on any error.
The allowlist goes by extension and path. An example is .md files and images under docs/ that no prompt file names.
JSON and YAML and scripts and lock files are never on the allowlist.
Add a test for each forge case. The cases are the script edited in the PR and a hook renamed to docs.
The forge cases also include a push after the tier time and a truncated file list.
ac7-1: add an AgDR-0116 evolution entry for the scripted tier.
right-size-ceremony.md states what the script allows. The rule and the script must match.
/code-review has 70 bytes left under its 16,000-byte cap. Keep it under the cap and run test_token_efficiency_wave1.sh.
ac7-4: cap a reviewer hand-back at 300 tokens.
ac7-4: the short delta format keeps the six headings that review_validate_rex_body requires. Each heading has a short body.
ac7-4: _lib-review-markers.sh stays unedited (C1). Add a test that a short delta body passes the validator.
ac7-6: recompute the resume window from current numbers. A Rex spawn is about 26.8k tokens in the rex-hakim trim report.
ac7-6: the owner trial sets subagentPromptCacheTtl to 1h in user settings. The framework default stays 5 minutes. The window states both cases.
ac7-6: a fresh Rex reads earlier findings from the posted review by review id and commit range. It does not read an orchestrator summary.
Keep a separate flip table for each Rex prompt edit. Then either edit can be dropped as a step.
ac7-6 metric: report resume rebuilds per 100 reviewer runs with the o1 script against the baseline of 3.87.
C3: record the before and after numbers in the PR body.
exclude: Any edit to block-unreviewed-merge.sh or block-merge-on-red-ci.sh or another merge-gate hook (C1)
A smaller model or a lower effort for Rex (C2)
ac5-3 and the lean-effort delta agent file
A self-declared tier or a tier rail inside the merge gate
The o2 build slice and the o5 effort spike slice
ac7-3 paired adversarial docs-only test beyond the forge cases
